# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

This repository was created by [Working Copy](https://workingcopy.app/?ct=holiday) to decorate the GitHub Activity Overview. It's a lightweight, holiday-themed repository that serves as a fun way to maintain GitHub activity presence.

## Purpose

- Keep GitHub activity graph active during holiday periods
- Serve as a demonstration repository for Git workflows
- Provide a simple, low-maintenance repository structure

## Repository Guidelines

### General Practices

- Keep the repository simple and minimal
- Focus on documentation over code complexity
- Maintain a clean commit history
- Use clear, descriptive commit messages

### File Structure

- `README.md` - Main repository documentation
- `.github/` - GitHub configuration files including Copilot instructions

### Coding Standards

When adding code or scripts to this repository:

- Use clear, self-documenting code
- Add comments for complex logic
- Follow language-specific best practices
- Keep files small and focused

### Markdown Style

- Use proper heading hierarchy (# for title, ## for sections, ### for subsections)
- Keep lines reasonably short for better readability
- Use lists for multiple related items
- Include links with descriptive text

### Commit Messages

- Use present tense ("Add feature" not "Added feature")
- Start with a capital letter
- Keep the first line under 50 characters when possible
- Add detailed description for complex changes

## Dependencies

This is a minimal repository with no external dependencies. If dependencies are added:

- Document them clearly in the README
- Use standard package managers
- Keep dependencies up to date
- Consider security implications

## Testing

For this simple repository:

- Manual verification is sufficient for changes
- Ensure all links work correctly
- Verify Markdown rendering on GitHub

## Maintenance

- Keep documentation current and accurate
- Remove outdated information promptly
- Welcome improvements and suggestions
- Maintain the holiday spirit and fun nature of the project
